item.description:

Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-07 Fisica tecnica e ingegneria nucleare

The research activities are structured along two main lines. First, lignocellulosic biomasses available in mountain areas (agricultural and forestry residues) will be identified and thoroughly characterized by selecting representative samples with partners’ support and performing physico chemical analyses (composition, CHNS and TGA) to assess their suitability for valorisation. Second, within an integrated biomass valorisation approach, the work will focus on the lignin fraction dissolved in black liquor, by developing and validating continuous thermochemical hydrothermal liquefaction (HTL) processes. The research activity is to develop metallic porous surfaces infused with lubricating liquids (Slippery Liquid-Infused Porous Surfaces, SLIPS) using Cold Spray technology. The project will explore innovative strategies for producing porous deposits by optimizing process parameters and employing pore-forming agents and erosive particles. The resulting deposits will then be functionalized and infused with lubricants to create SLIPS. item.title: Incarico post-doc: ReaCer - Reactive sintering of ceramics – project code FA8655-26-1-B029 (CUP E63C26001640005) (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-11 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IMAT-01 Scienza e tecnologia dei materiali

ReaCer aims to develop a new fundamental understanding of the consolidation mechanisms activated in reactive hydrothermal liquid-phase sintering, RHLPS. The main goal is to identify a kinetic model for the process and bind it to the physics of the system. This will allow us to clarify the rate-controlling bottlenecks for the reactive consolidation, the diffusion pathways, and the activation energy of the process. Remarkably, the assumptions behind this consolidation approach are mechanistically different from those mastering the traditional solid-state sintering models. The fellow should propose a set of experiments that will allow the identification of a physical model for the system…
